title: Resources
intro_short: Official links, forms and documents for students and parents — kept in one place.
intro_full: A single place for the official links, application forms and documents that students and parents ask for most often — scholarship and education-loan portals, exam bodies, admission and counselling links, career and skill resources, and downloadable checklists. Every link points to the official source. This page is maintained alongside our other career-counselling pages.

sections.heading: Scholarships & Finance
sections.body: The scholarship and education-loan portals students use most — always the government's own website.

sections.heading: Common Questions
sections.body: The questions students and parents ask most — answered briefly.

items.title: How do I apply for a scholarship?
items.body: Start at the National Scholarship Portal (NSP); keep marksheets, income and bank details ready.

items.title: How do I get an education loan?
items.body: Use PM-Vidyalaxmi for collateral-free loans and interest subvention.

items.title: Which admission portal should I use?
items.body: Medical -> MCC; engineering (IIT/NIT) -> JoSAA; UP technical -> UPTAC.

items.title: Is this the official link?
items.body: Every link here goes to the government's or the exam body's own website. Do not trust look-alike sites or agents who ask for money.
